description: issue #686 (slice I7): the STATIC checker treats an `on_key` handler body as a fresh control-flow boundary, not a procedure body - so `return` inside it is `return` outside any procedure (ol-return-outside-proc, spec/error-model.md, issue #114), exactly as it does for a `when` body (interaction-events/when/when-return-in-handler-checked). This is the check-mode companion to slice I7's runtime dispatch work: it locks the checker's agreement with the runtime for the handler kind whose delivery this slice added, and gives the profile a `check: true` fixture in the dispatch area (M4 finding F3: a profile shipping a checker with no check fixture leaves its checker gaps green). `interaction-events` is now IN SUPPORTED_PROFILES (claimed by terminal slice #688); a fixture's `profiles` list has always been independent of that claim, requesting the profile for check() name visibility either way.
